competences.description: Attacks the enemy with an axe to inflict 2 Continuous Damage effects for 1 turn with a 50% chance.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)

competences.description: Throws an axe and stuns the enemy for 1 turn and disturbs the enemy's HP recovery for 2 turns with an 80% chance each. The enemy defeated from this attack while you are under Berserk state cannot be revived during the battle.

effets.description: The target will be stunned and won't be able to attack.
The target's HP cannot be recovered.
Prevents an enemy from being resurrected after being killed.

competences.description: Strikes the enemy with an axe. This attack will ignore all effects that resist death. Goes under [Berserk] state for 3 turns afterwards. Under Berserk state, the Defense is decreased by 30%, damage dealt to enemies is increased by 100%, Attack Speed is increased by 20% and HP is recovered by 10% of the damage dealt.

effets.description: Under Berserk state, Defense is decreased by 30%, the damage dealt to enemies is increased by 100%, Attack Speed is increased by 20% and HP is recoverd by 10% of the damage dealt.
